description: Selezione Edifici 2020 per potenzialità fotovoltaico is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Provincia Autonoma di Trento - Agenzia Provinciale per le Risorse Idriche e l'Energia - Ufficio Studi e Pianificazione delle Risorse Energetiche. The thematic is the “buildings” layer present on the Provincial Technical Charter, excluding buildings subject to cultural and integrated interest of the new buildings identified through the 2020 orthophotos, it is functional to the identification of the buildings on the map of irradiation for the purposes of calculating the photovoltaic potential. Coverage: Provincia Autonoma di Trento - Agenzia Provinciale per le Risorse Idriche e l'Energia - Ufficio Studi e Pianificazione delle Risorse Energetiche. The portal shows the English title as "Selection of buildings 2020 for photovoltaic potential" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Provincia Autonoma di Trento - Agenzia Provinciale per le Risorse Idriche e l'Energia - Ufficio Studi e Pianificazione delle Risorse Energetiche. Its keywords include RNDT, open data, edificato, irraggiamento, fotovoltaico, energia. The listing shows 2023-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
